CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.p6_subscription_access_status(p_tenant_id bigint, p_now timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now())
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select case
    when not exists (select 1 from public.tenant_subscriptions s where s.tenant_id=p_tenant_id) then 'missing'
    when exists (select 1 from public.tenant_subscriptions s where s.tenant_id=p_tenant_id and s.status in ('suspended','cancelled','overdue')) then 'blocked'
    when exists (select 1 from public.tenant_subscriptions s where s.tenant_id=p_tenant_id and s.ends_at > p_now and s.status in ('trial','active')) then 'active'
    else 'expired'
  end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.powerhub_ensure_owner_main_site()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ declare v_site_id bigint; v_owner_user_id bigint; begin select id into v_site_id from public.sites where tenant_id = new.tenant_id order by case when name = 'الفرع الرئيسي' then 0 else 1 end, id limit 1; if v_site_id is null then select user_id into v_owner_user_id from public.tenant_members where tenant_id = new.tenant_id and role = 'owner' and is_active = true order by id limit 1; insert into public.sites (tenant_id, name, code, status) values (new.tenant_id, 'الفرع الرئيسي', 'SITE-' || upper(substr(replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''), 1, 8)), 'active') returning id into v_site_id; if v_owner_user_id is not null then insert into public.staff_profiles (tenant_id, site_id, user_id, role, is_active) values (new.tenant_id, v_site_id, v_owner_user_id, 'owner', true) on conflict do nothing; end if; else select user_id into v_owner_user_id from public.tenant_members where tenant_id = new.tenant_id and role = 'owner' and is_active = true order by id limit 1; if v_owner_user_id is not null then insert into public.staff_profiles (tenant_id, site_id, user_id, role, is_active) values (new.tenant_id, v_site_id, v_owner_user_id, 'owner', true) on conflict do nothing; end if; end if; return new; end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.powerhub_financial_period_cash_flow_raw(p_tenant_id bigint, p_site_id bigint, p_period_start timestamp with time zone, p_period_end_exclusive timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'asOf', now(),
    'scopeSiteId',p_site_id,
    'externalCashIn',COALESCE(SUM(t.amount) FILTER (
      WHERE t.transaction_type IN ('collection','deposit')),0),
    'externalCashOut',COALESCE(SUM(t.amount) FILTER (
      WHERE t.transaction_type='withdrawal'),0),
    'netCashFlow',COALESCE(SUM(CASE
      WHEN t.transaction_type IN ('collection','deposit') THEN t.amount
      WHEN t.transaction_type='withdrawal' THEN -t.amount
      ELSE 0 END),0),
    'internalTransferVolume',COALESCE(SUM(t.amount) FILTER (
      WHERE t.transaction_type='transfer_out'),0),
    'transactionCount',COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE t.transaction_type IN ('collection','deposit','withdrawal')),
    'scopeNotice','site_attributed_only'
  )
  FROM public.account_transactions t
  WHERE t.tenant_id=p_tenant_id AND t.site_id=p_site_id
    AND t.occurred_at>=p_period_start AND t.occurred_at<p_period_end_exclusive
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.powerhub_mobile_touch_session(p_session_id bigint, p_user_id bigint, p_tenant_id bigint, p_now timestamp with time zone DEFAULT clock_timestamp())
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if p_session_id is null or p_session_id <= 0
     or p_user_id is null or p_user_id <= 0
     or p_tenant_id is null or p_tenant_id <= 0
     or p_now is null then
    return false;
  end if;

  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(
    hashtextextended('powerhub-mobile-single-session:' || p_user_id::text, 0)
  );

  update public.mobile_api_sessions as s
     set last_used_at = p_now
   where s.id = p_session_id
     and s.user_id = p_user_id
     and s.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
     and s.revoked_at is null
     and s.expires_at > p_now;

  return found;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.powerhub_refresh_fuel_maintenance_delta_after_generator_name_up()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare v_row record;
begin
  if OLD.name is not distinct from NEW.name then return NEW; end if;
  for v_row in
    select visible.id from (
      select e.id,e.generator_id from public.generator_fuel_events e
      where e.tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id and e.site_id=NEW.site_id
      order by e.occurred_at desc,e.id desc limit 500
    ) visible
    where visible.generator_id=NEW.id order by visible.id
  loop
    perform public.powerhub_emit_fuel_maintenance_delta_sync_change(NEW.tenant_id,NEW.site_id,'fuel_events',v_row.id);
  end loop;
  for v_row in
    select visible.id from (
      select w.id,w.generator_id from public.generator_maintenance_work_orders w
      where w.tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id and w.site_id=NEW.site_id
      order by coalesce(w.reported_at,w.created_at) desc,w.id desc limit 200
    ) visible
    where visible.generator_id=NEW.id order by visible.id
  loop
    perform public.powerhub_emit_fuel_maintenance_delta_sync_change(NEW.tenant_id,NEW.site_id,'maintenance_work_orders',v_row.id);
  end loop;
  return NEW;
end $function$
